messages:
alex_garcia: Heads up — we got a customer request (from Kelly in CS) asking for an immediate remediation timeline and evidence for a transitive vuln they found in our private deploy package. CVE is CVE-2026-12345; appears in a transitive lib used by our container image.
kelly_cs: Customer wants: 1) SBOM for the specific image they run, 2) patch ETA, 3) confirmation of KMS key rotation/audit logs, and 4) formal statement they can include in their SOC2 evidence pack. They flagged compliance deadline next Tue.
maya: Do we have a per-image SBOM generation step for private deploys? I thought that was gated behind a manual run.
samir: We do. It's an internal job that runs during release — generates SPDX JSON and uploads to GCS. For private on-prem installs we include the sbom.tar.gz in the artifact bundle, but we haven't been auto-building for older images customers pinned.
alex_garcia: Customer is pinned to 2025.11.2 — so the dev build won't have the auto-SBOM. Options: a) backport patch + publish patched image + SBOM, b) produce SBOM for their exact pinned image and send, plus mitigation guidance, or c) hotpatch layer and provide signed attestation.
devops_oncall: Hotpatching a pinned GA image for a customer is doable but we need an approvals log. Also KMS key access: if they use Redwood Private with customer-managed KMS, we can't rotate their customer key — they'd need to run rotation locally. For cloud-managed keys we can rotate and provide audit events.
security_bot: [automated] New advisory matched: CVE-2026-12345 — severity=HIGH, vector=NETWORK, package=libx-transitive@2.3.4. Suggested fix: upgrade transitive to >=2.3.9 or apply patch. References: https://cve.example/CVE-2026-12345
maya: For the compliance statement: legal needs a short template. I can draft one, but we need exact remediation steps and timeline from eng.
samir: Triage summary from runtime team: the vuln is only exploitable if customers accept untrusted model artifacts via our import API (which is disabled by default). However the vulnerable code path exists in the image, so it's still a compliance risk for customers wanting a binary SBOM.
alex_garcia: Priority decision: Customer asked for "remediation timeline + evidence" before Tue. Proposed plan: 1) Generate SBOM for pinned image and send today (low effort). 2) Provide mitigation statement + workaround (disable import API / tighten RBAC) — immediate. 3) Schedule a backport patch to base image in 48 hours, hotpatch release in 72 hours if backport testing passes. 4) For KMS: provide audit logs of last rotation and offer to coordinate customer key rotation steps.
kelly_cs: Customer will accept SBOM + mitigation if we also provide a signed follow-up once patch is out. They want to know whether the fix requires downtime.
devops_oncall: Hotpatch should be no-downtime — it's a layered image update we roll with blue/green. Backport may require a short rolling restart per instance (2-5 minutes). I'll quantify in the release note.
maya: For the SOC2 evidence, they often want a snapshot: SBOM file, signed email from security, KMS rotation event log, and a remediation ticket with owner + ETA. We'll need a ticket ID and owner.
alex_garcia: Action items:
- samir: produce SBOM for 2025.11.2, attach SPDX JSON and sha256, deliver to kelly_cs by EOD (ts 1876547600). (assignee)
- devops_oncall: prepare hotpatch plan and downtime estimate, add rollback steps, post runbook link. (due +72h)
- maya: draft SOC2 statement template and sign-off checklist; loop legal. (due EOD)
- alex_garcia: create remediation ticket in tracker and assign to runtime (link will be shared here).
samir: Acknowledged. I'll run the SBOM job locally and redacted it for PII, then upload to gs://redwood-sboms/customer-supplied/kelly_cs/2025.11.2/
security_bot: [automated] Ticket created: SEC-2026-4497 — vulnerability triage and remediation for CVE-2026-12345. Priority=High.
kelly_cs: Customer confirmed timeline acceptance as long as SBOM and mitigation statement are in their hands today. Also asked if we can provide KMS audit logs showing last rotation timestamp.
devops_oncall: For cloud-managed KMS we can export rotation events from Stackdriver/Audit logs. I'll pull the last two rotations for the key used in 2025.11.2 image build chain and redact requester identities before sending.
alex_garcia: Once SBOM and rotation logs are sent, I'll prepare a short signed note (on corporate letterhead) describing the fix plan and linking to SEC-2026-4497. That should satisfy their SOC2 pack until the patch lands.
maya: Legal wants the phrase: "No known active exploitation; timely remediation planned" — don't state zero-risk. I'll coordinate the exact wording.
samir: SBOM job complete locally. Upload link: gs://redwood-sboms/customer-supplied/kelly_cs/2025.11.2/spdx.json.sha256=6f8a... I'll post the full link once uploaded. Testing backport now.
devops_oncall: Hotpatch runbook draft: https://go/runbooks/hotpatch-cve-2026-12345 (internal). ETA for schedule and rollout: 72 hours, estimated 3-5 minute rolling restarts per instance for backported images.
kelly_cs: Customer acknowledged receipt of the SBOM link and rotation timestamps. Waiting for the signed remediation note.
alex_garcia: I'll attach SEC-2026-4497 and the sign-off once legal approves. Thanks all — keep updates here and ping if blockers.
maya: Legal approved wording. alex_garcia please send signed note and I'll file it to the customer's SOC2 evidence portal.
alex_garcia: Sent the signed note to Kelly and uploaded to the portal. Marking this thread as in-flight. Will update after hotpatch completes.
